required_effects.reason: All four evaluated callback groups, including empty groups, in restore-lisp-pointers traversal order. Bind callback objects directly, not their printed variable labels.
All paired compile-time effects in r7. Completion events witness execution; semantic prerequisite edges still need qualification.
Keep every emitted load effect, including effects not executed by the compiling host. Emission is not execution.

scope_limits: This proposed seed set is not an independently reviewed seed set and confers no LL15 acceptance.

The finite candidate universe retains all r7 compiler bodies and all resident clean-image code prototypes, including inspector code. It is not a proved bound on arbitrary future EVAL, FASL loading, rebinding, plugins, or all stub-backend paths.
No bootstrap implementation is repaired by scanning the heap or rebinding names; this is observation only.
S0-LL08-a static reachability and operator/lowering/effect qualification remain prerequisites to the complete census.
